project.name: Timbaland (late 90s / 2000s)
project.notes:
TIMBALAND  (Missy Elliott, Aaliyah, Ginuwine; late 1990s-2000s)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- Started on an Ensoniq EPS, then an ASR-10 (Vice). Later rig: ASR-10, Triton, Motif (Music
  Thing blog relaying Remix, 2004).
- "Get Ur Freak On" used Zero-G's "Spices of India" library (MusicRadar).
- His own account of vocal percussion and stutter edits: unconfirmed.

THIS TEMPLATE
Rack drums at 58% swing (The drum rack plays one-shots synthesized for these templates (CC0, no recordings), in the voice of the machine each channel is named for, with a starter beat in the pattern; replace them with your own samples for the real machine.), a Mouth Percussion Sampler (SP Comp) for beatboxed hits you
record, a stutter track (a short, high-feedback Tape Delay on an OB-Xf percussion patch), sub
bass, an English Horn lead for the "exotic" lines, a choir pad.

WORKFLOW
Leave space: drums and bass first, every other part enters one at a time. For stutters chop
and repeat in the Sampler or the Step Sequencer; the Tape Delay on Stutter / Glitch only
echoes.

MIX NOTES
- Dry and close: very short reverbs; the bass is sub-only, the kick very short.
- Drum Bus: built-in compression and Overdrive. Master: built-in glue, Lemon Limiter; -10 to -8
  LUFS.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Medium. No ASR-10 model, no Indian instrument library (the OB-Xf winds stand in), no
stutter sequencer; the drums are synthesized one-shots, not samples of the machines.

SOURCES
Vice "Timbaland: The Emperor of Sound"; Music Thing blog (2004); MusicRadar "Get Ur Freak On";
Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 100 BPM, 4/4, key Bbmin, cycle bars 1-4.

Tracks
- Drums (Instrument, +0 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Channel Rack (synthesized one-shots of the template samples: Kick (808) = kick-808.wav, Snare (808) = snare-808.wav, Closed Hat (808) = hat-808.wav, Open Hat (808) = openhat-808.wav, Clap (909) = clap.wav, Rim (909) = rim.wav, 505 Clap = clap.wav)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 4, Attack 30, Release 80, Make-up 2)
    region: Step Sequencer pattern with a starter beat (15 steps on), swing 58% (MPC terms), 7 rows = the rack's channels
- Mouth Percussion (Instrument, -4 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Sampler (SP-303 model): effect Comp on, CTRL 1-3 = 60%, 30%, 70%; quantize 16; pad grade standard
- Stutter / Glitch (Instrument, -10 dB) -> Drum Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Percussion/Robo Percer"
    strip FX: Tape Delay (Time 75, Feedback 0.6, Tone 8000, Mix 0.5)
- Sub Bass (Instrument, -5 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Basses/Sub 1"
- Exotic Lead (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Winds/English Horn"
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -14 dB
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -16 dB
- Pad (Instrument, -16 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Pads/Retro Choir"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -12 dB
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -20, Ratio 4, Attack 0.5, Release 60, Make-up 3)
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -18 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -18 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Drum Bus (bus 1): Compressor (Ratio 4, Release 100, Make-up 3); Overdrive (Tone 7000, Mix 0.5)
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 1.4, Decay Curve 1, IR "01.2s Medium Hall")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 450, Feedback 0.2, Tone 5000, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Threshold -12, Ratio 2, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): Lemon Limiter: gain +4 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
